contexts.text: A nucleus of a Church always remains... So with the Most Ancient Church, a residue remained even to the Flood, and continued after it. This residue of the Church is called Noah. AC 468:2.
He that is left in Zion, and He that remains in Jerusalem (). Explained.
Here the residue is called a seed of holiness.
Although there was no life of faith left.
The rest fled into the mountain () = that not all were overcome.
That which is left shall Aaron and his sons eat () = what is reciprocal of man, and appropriation...
Those left of His people () = goods and truths which survive.
Remains, and residues, in the Word. Explained, Illustrated. AC 5899.
The residue of what is... left from the hail () = the truth not consumed by the former falsity.
No green thing left () = everything sensitive of truth obliterated.
What is left until the morning () = a middle state...
Let no one leave of it until the morning () = not to be solicitous to acquire it of themselves. Explained. AC 8478:2. AC 8480.
What they leave () = what has been left by them. Explained.
The rejection of the residue from the mother. Signified.
Vastated until little life is left. Explained.
Those left () = all things left of the Church, ( = all things which are hatched from this principle. AE 386:3.)
